そして星々をその手に{br}つかまんとした者達{end}
entries.en: And those who reached out{br}to seize the stars.{end}

entries.jp: {skip:0100}だが忘れることなかれ{br}多くの獅子達が返り血をあび{br}{skip:0200}駆け巡った時代を{br}{skip:0100}自分の信じるもののため{br}己の全てを投げうった時代を{br}人はこれを銀河戦国群雄伝と{br}{skip:0200}後世に伝えている{end}
entries.en: {skip:0100}But never forget the age{br}when many lions, drenched in blood,{br}{skip:0200}raced across the stars; the age{br}{skip:0100}when each threw away everything{br}for what they believed in.{br}This age, posterity calls the{br}{skip:0200}Chronicle of Galactic Warlords.{end}
